raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

PD publishes a KV byte layout on the bootstrap server (`kv_args.kv_layout`, from `disaggregation.utils.get_pd_kv_layout`). It refuses to pair a prefill and a decode server that declare different layouts. Today only `DeepSeekV4TokenToKVPool` can declare one, via an `isinstance` special case. Other pools whose bytes are not the default layout have no way to say so. That includes out-of-tree platform pools, e.g. a Neuron pool that is head-major inside a page. Their peers then pair silently and exchange misinterpreted bytes. The heterogeneous-TP slice path assumes token-major rows (see the companion NIXL slice fix, which refuses declared layouts there).

## Modifications

- `KVCache.pd_kv_layout() -> Optional[str]`, default `None`, meaning the pool class's default layout. `DeepSeekV4TokenToKVPool` already defines this method, so it now simply overrides it.
- `HybridLinearKVPool.pd_kv_layout()` forwards to its `full_kv_pool`, since that is the pool whose KV bytes PD transfers.
- `get_pd_kv_layout` calls `pool.pd_kv_layout()` when the pool defines it, and returns `None` otherwise. The DeepSeek-V4 import and `isinstance` check are gone.
- The mismatch error message no longer names only the DSV4 flags.

There is no wire or behavior change for in-tree pools. DeepSeek-V4 declares the same string as before, and every other in-tree pool declares `None`, as before.

## How it was found

This came up while building an out-of-tree Neuron/Trainium platform plugin. Its KV pool lays a page out as `[head][token][dim]`, so it had to monkeypatch `get_pd_kv_layout` to declare that. Without the declaration, upstream's slice transfer wrote NHD-shaped descriptors into it.

## Accuracy Tests

N/A. This is a refactor with no change for in-tree pools.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

N/A.

## Tests

- Run (macOS, CPU only): `test/registered/unit/disaggregation/test_pd_kv_layout_protocol.py` (new): the default is None, a subclass declares its layout, the hybrid linear pool forwards, objects without the method declare nothing, and DSV4 still overrides. Also ran `test_dsv4_unified_fp8_pd.py` and `test_register_to_bootstrap.py`. 9 passed in total.
- Not run: GPU PD e2e (DeepSeek-V4 PD handshake on hardware).

## Open questions

- The bootstrap check only refuses when *both* sides declare a layout (`info.kv_layout is not None and self.kv_layout is not None`). A prefill that declares a non-default layout can still pair with a decode that declares `None` (the default layout). That keeps compatibility with servers that predate the field. Should a declared layout vs `None` be refused too, at least for layouts outside the DSV4 family? Or should pools be able to mark their layout as "must match exactly"?
- Should `SWAKVPool` (and other wrappers) also forward, or declare a combined layout?

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

## Review and Merge Process

1. Ping Merge Oncalls to start the process. See the [PR Merge Process](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/MAINTAINER.md#pull-request-merge-process).
2. Get approvals from [CODEOWNERS](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/CODEOWNERS) and other reviewers.
3. Trigger CI tests with [comments](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#how-to-trigger-ci-tests) or contact authorized users to do so.
4. After green CI and required approvals, ask Merge Oncalls or people with Write permission to merge the PR.

+"""CPU tests for the pool-declared PD KV layout (``KVCache.pd_kv_layout``)."""
+
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
+
+register_cpu_ci(est_time=2, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
+
+
+import unittest
+
+from sglang.srt.disaggregation.utils import get_pd_kv_layout
+from sglang.srt.mem_cache.deepseek_v4_memory_pool import DeepSeekV4TokenToKVPool
+from sglang.srt.mem_cache.memory_pool import (
+    HybridLinearKVPool,
+    KVCache,
+    MHATokenToKVPool,
+)
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase
+
+
+class _OutOfTreePool(MHATokenToKVPool):
+    """Stand-in for a platform pool with a different byte layout."""
+
+    def __init__(self):  # skip buffer allocation
+        pass
+
+    def pd_kv_layout(self):
+        return "head_major_in_page"
+
+
+class TestPdKvLayoutProtocol(CustomTestCase):
+    def test_default_pool_declares_nothing(self):
+        pool = object.__new__(MHATokenToKVPool)
+        self.assertIsNone(pool.pd_kv_layout())
+        self.assertIsNone(get_pd_kv_layout(pool))
+
+    def test_subclass_declares_its_layout(self):
+        self.assertEqual(get_pd_kv_layout(_OutOfTreePool()), "head_major_in_page")
+
+    def test_hybrid_linear_pool_forwards_the_full_attention_pool(self):
+        hybrid = object.__new__(HybridLinearKVPool)
+        hybrid.full_kv_pool = _OutOfTreePool()
+        self.assertEqual(get_pd_kv_layout(hybrid), "head_major_in_page")
+        hybrid.full_kv_pool = object.__new__(MHATokenToKVPool)
+        self.assertIsNone(get_pd_kv_layout(hybrid))
+
+    def test_objects_without_the_method_declare_nothing(self):
+        self.assertIsNone(get_pd_kv_layout(object()))
+        self.assertIsNone(get_pd_kv_layout(None))
+
+    def test_deepseek_v4_pool_still_declares_through_the_protocol(self):
+        self.assertTrue(issubclass(DeepSeekV4TokenToKVPool, KVCache))
+        self.assertIsNot(DeepSeekV4TokenToKVPool.pd_kv_layout, KVCache.pd_kv_layout)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
